items.prompt: Which statement about ordering numbers is true?

options.text: Compare the greatest place first, then continue right when digits are equal.

items.explanation: Compare the greatest place first. If the digits match, move right to the next place until the numbers differ.

items.prompt: Which order is least to greatest?
items.explanation: All start with 1 thousand. Compare hundreds: 1,205 and 1,250 have 2 hundreds, but 1,520 has 5, so 1,520 is greatest. Then 1,205 < 1,250 because 0 tens < 5 tens.

items.prompt: Which is NOT a correct way to order numbers?
items.explanation: Numbers are ordered by comparing place values, not by the alphabet.
All start with 1 thousand. 1,205 has 2 hundreds and 0 tens, the smallest, so it is least.
In greatest-to-least order, 2,310 comes first because it has 3 tens and 2,301 has 0 tens.
